legends.ridge: Green opacity: raw directional valley response;255=response0.15 or higher. Not a probability.
legends.density-confidence: Yellow opacity: supported local density strength0..1; transparent=rejected. Not statistically calibrated.
legends.traces: Green=analysis-accepted, red=rejected. Renderer eligibility is separately recorded.
legends.accepted-traces: Green=candidates meeting renderer confidence and connectivity gates.
legends.rejected-traces: Red=rejected traces; reasons and counts are recorded in perEye JSON.
legends.orientation: Cyan=measured tangent, display arrow5 analysis-px, NOT product extension.
legends.tip-width-extension: Cyan=measured tangent; yellow=half-contrast width; magenta=actual Length100 geometry, not exaggerated.
legends.crossing-structures: Orange=observed lines crossing the predicted opening and continuing beyond the lower lid; negative occlusion evidence.
legends.difference: Absolute natural-minus-original RGB difference amplified8x; black=identity. JSON maxRGBSum is per-pixel RGB L1,0..765.
